capabilities: Capture tasks to an inbox with quick capture commands
View tasks in an agenda grouped by today, this week, this month, and future
Track time per task with timers, Pomodoro cycles, and CLOCK records
Organize tasks with priorities, scheduled/deadline dates, subtask indentation, and repeat dates
Visualize daily work in a 24-hour timeline and per-task statistics with CSV export
extras: Not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff; README includes manual installation steps while pending review. Includes a configurable morning reminder inspired by Huberman Lab, disabled by default.
motivation: The author uses Emacs org-mode for their personal GTD system and built the plugin to bring the same task model to Obsidian users without requiring Emacs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in org-mode style GTD system with agenda views, CLOCK time logs, or structured task folders.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Emacs org-mode — designed for Obsidian.

summary: Task management plugin that adds an org-mode style GTD workflow with TODO states, priorities, scheduled dates, agenda view, and time tracking.
